structure_definition.title: Org Abc123 (Sample Hospital) Organization Profile
structure_definition.description: Tenant-layer profile for org_abc123, a sample registered hospital. Narrows the India country profile (in-organization) one step further: this tenant IS a registered ABDM healthcare facility, so the hfr-id identifier slice — optional (0..1) at the generic country layer, since not every Organization under that profile is itself a facility — is tightened to required (1..1) here.

element.short: ABDM Health Facility Registry ID (required for this tenant)
